completion: All five files present and valid; any failure_report.json entry, including a dangling link, invalidates completion. Undefined inferential endpoints with declared statuses are valid complete outputs.

serialization.json: Objects with unique keys; finite typed numbers, exact Boolean or null as declared. Numeric strings are not JSON numbers.
serialization.csv: Numeric decimal/scientific notation accepted; identity strings preserved literally; additional columns allowed and ignored.
serialization.npz: Unpickled primitive real-numeric, Boolean or UTF-8 string arrays only. No object/structured/complex arrays; no nonfinite required or extra arrays. Stored or deflate ZIP members, one unique safe .npy basename each; NPY version 1 or 2.
serialization.integer_axes: Exact value-integral finite non-Boolean numeric arrays accepted, including floats; no dtype fingerprint.
serialization.extras: Finite bounded descriptive JSON fields, NPZ arrays, CSV columns and additional regular files allowed. They do not override any required value. Optional fit/support diagnostics are not numerical targets.
serialization.unsafe_paths: No symlinks (including ancestors/members), special files, duplicate archive members or pickle. File bytes are checked before/after bounded same-buffer read.

authority.source: Private independently reconstructed canonical common ROI/edge membership and source Fisher-z.
authority.selections: Accepted source-bound Fisher-z, canonical subject/pair order and declared deterministic seed0, never hidden canonical sets.
authority.row_replay: Accepted stability.csv rows after comparison with selected accepted-z means/deltas; forward linear identity uses sum of all three receipt bounds.
authority.evidence: Duplicate first/second means are receipts against the same accepted-z computation, not replacement values for CSV and not exactly equated to separately rounded CSV.
authority.reliability: Accepted per-person reliability receipts after comparison with accepted-z/source-support replay drive reliability summaries.
authority.inference: Shared SHA-bound public/private selection_kernel, with source anchors on SAME accepted sets and declared resolution/fidelity. No second canonical t/p/TOST/Pearson/Spearman/count target.

tolerances.formula: abs(a-b)<=atol+rtol*abs(b). Fidelity support and status are exact source-defined, not inferred from displayed rounded numbers.

arrays.subject_ids: [40] unique literal decimal SUB_ID strings; exact mapped fixed cohort
arrays.edge_roi_j: [E] upper original ROI ID; every common-ROI pair i<j exactly once
arrays.fisher_z: [40,3,E] finite real non-Boolean numeric values; coherent subject/segment/edge permutation allowed

connectivity_npz.source_mask: All source-person x3-segment SD>1e-8; no support recomputation from receipts.

stability_csv.numeric_domain: All six means/deltas finite; signed values are allowed.
stability_csv.authority: All group delta/count/inference computations use these accepted rows in canonical subject order.

fields.training_subject_ids: all other39 exact identities; order immaterial
fields.forward_edge_indices: k unique exact integral JSON numeric indices into submitted edge axis; set order immaterial
fields.means: four scheme keys forward/reverse/independent/random, each {first:finite signed real,second:finite signed real}

summary_json.pins: same four exact pins as evidence
summary_json.cohort: 40 keyed records {file_id,subject_id}, literal source mapping; order immaterial
summary_json.source_files: Complete authenticated42 source-manifest member dictionaries keyed path; required record fields are exact, order immaterial; no substituted helper authority.

source_observed.phenotype_ledger: 1112 records keyed phenotype_row_index, with exact typed file_id,subject_id,source_subject_id_token,selected_derivative,source_path,tokens{SITE_ID,EYE_STATUS_AT_SCAN}; source order may be permuted coherently
source_observed.persons: closed FILE_ID dictionary. Required each: source_path/source_sha256/subject_id/phenotype_row_index/tokens/n_frames/n_columns/L/header/header_sha256/source_column_ids/all_finite/segment_support{first,second,full}/exact_constant_mask{first,second,full}; masks/source axes exact.

summary_json.software: object with nonempty python,numpy,scipy strings; descriptive, no exact version-string gate
summary_json.selection_schemes: four exact scheme keys, records specified below
summary_json.source_inference_support: four scheme keys, each {status:active|source_zero_variance|numerical_resolution}; numeric diagnostic extras optional/ungraded

group_record.null_policy: All t/p/CI null unless inference_status ok; descriptors retain own accepted-row values.

tost_record.equivalent_within_margin: Boolean or null, strict unrounded own replay p<.05
tost_record.status: same support/numerical status as independent group

findings: Nonempty UTF-8 text. Describe fixed-cohort single-run signed selection sensitivity and nominal inference limits. No prose, direction, significance, equivalence, magnitude or difficulty target.
interpretation: A fixed-cohort methods/control adaptation, not a paper-finding reproduction or a calibrated model-difficulty claim. No direction, significance, equivalence or endpoint outcome is required.
